name: Teesside University
description:
Teesside University is a popular educational institution based in Middlesbrough, North Yorkshire, England. The university was established in 1930 under the name Constantine Technical College. The college went on to become Teesside Polytechnic in 1969 and rose through the ranks over the years. The institution finally gained university status in 1992 and was named the University of Teesside before being renamed Teesside University in 2009.

Teesside University offers over 600 courses in business and management, engineering, humanities and law, health and life services, and many other fields of study. The university hosts more than 22,000 students and is a famous educational institution in the UK.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: If you’re looking for a university that gives you a mix of academics and strong career prospects, Teesside University is the right choice. The university earned a Gold rating in the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) 2023, showing its strong commitment to top-quality teaching. Whether you're into business, health sciences, computing, or the arts, Teesside offers a wide range of courses.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: Teesside University offers you a rich student experience and a supportive environment. You’ll see that the university is recognised as the top in North East England for overall student experience. Plus, you’ll get confidential counselling and advice services through the Student Assistance Programme. Teesside also offers you many different wellbeing initiatives. And what’s more, with over 100 active clubs and societies, you’ll always be engaged in something on campus.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Teesside University offers you various on-campus accommodations. You can choose from their 6 residences, all near the campus. These include en-suite and private options. At all the residences, you’ll get all the amenities you need for a comfortable living.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Teesside University's Library is your central hub for learning and research. You’ll have access to over 500 computers, along with a massive digital collection that includes around 490,000 eBooks, 97,000 e-journals, and 200 academic databases.

Sports
The university has invested over GBP 2.75 million in its on-campus gym. This modern facility is open to both students and staff, giving you access to everything you need to stay active and healthy. There’s even a sprint track for high-intensity training and performance work. Plus, you can also access the River Tees Water Sports Centre for rowing, canoeing, and kayaking, and nearby facilities like the Middlesbrough Cycle Circuit and Tennis World.

Laboratory
You’ll find many state-of-the-art laboratories across various disciplines. These include the Bios Building with biology suites, food science and technology labs. Then you have other facilities like the Orion Building and the National Horizons Centre.

Cafeteria
The university offers you a variety of dining options. You can get tasty dishes at the Food Quarter, on the ground floor of the Library. You can also get quick bites and beverages at Vita, situated in the BIOS building, and at the STREAT in the Student Life building as well.
